coverage.finding: Coverage is unchanged from v188/v189; all 130 mapped topics remain covered with at least four questions.

heuristic_comparison.note: Heuristics are screening signals only. The absolute-word count did not improve in net terms because one repaired OSS distractor introduced a new 必ず asymmetry while coreq_15_07_1 was cleared.

high_priority_groups.reason: two direct availability-formula drills remain strongly similar after challenge_025 was diversified
one-character correct state is conspicuous beside verbose distractors; one distractor also uses 必ず
the correct architecture term is much longer and the three distractors are weakly related to system architecture
OSS distractors still lean on absolute claims such as 必ず/すべて; coreq_06_05_1 is a new heuristic regression from v189
terse stem and implausible distractors remain easy to eliminate without domain knowledge

manual_priority_review.finding: v189 materially reduced true duplicate and answer-length issues. The next batch should target the seven remaining High IDs first; do not rewrite resolved partner questions merely because they were High in v188.

decision.recommended_v191: Repair the seven current High IDs, then select at most three Medium IDs with the clearest difficulty/cognitive or repeated-template defect. Preserve 710/710 IDs, answer distribution and cognitive counts.
